technical.summary: NI displays solid uptrend structure with price above all MAs, rising RSI/MACD, and three white soldiers pattern, but lacks triggering strategy signal and active crossover confirmation, suggesting a cautious entry on secondary confirmation rather than primary signal.

fundamental.summary: No insider or institutional signals detected; 27 days to earnings provides reasonable buffer, but lack of smart money activity suggests limited conviction.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (VIX-equivalent 30) creates contrarian buy signal while mixed AAII sentiment (42% bullish) and negative commercial positioning suggest underlying weakness; congressional data absent.

risk.summary: FOMC decision imminent (passed event date) with elevated VIX at 30.49 creates unfavourable conditions for swing trade entry in defensive utility sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with price above all MAs, rising RSI across timeframes, three white soldiers pattern, and supertrend bullish signal creates solid uptrend foundation with contrarian buy opportunity in fear zone (VIX 30).
debate.key_bear_argument: Trade-blocking macro environment with FOMC decision just passed, elevated VIX (30.49), no active strategy triggers, absence of smart money alignment, and lack of crossover confirmation signals combine to create unfavourable risk-reward for swing entry in defensive sector.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical uptrend structure lacks strategy trigger confirmation and is heavily undermined by trade-blocking macro conditions: FOMC decision passed, elevated VIX (30.49), and absence of smart money conviction in defensive utility sector.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent macro volatility from FOMC aftermath combined with high VIX creates unfavourable risk-reward; no active strategy triggers provide weak entry confirmation.
